d:
Former cricketer Praveen Kumar is in Guest in the Newsroom. He talks about MS Dhoni's captaincy, Rohit's fight and the Kohli-Gambhir dispute. Praveen revealed many secrets of the dressing room. He accused the senior players of defaming him. Praveen alleged that a senior player deliberately created the image of him as a drunkard. Watch Praveen Kumar's full interview with Saurabh Dwivedi.
Produced By: The Lallantop
Edited By: Ravi Gangwar
